_meta.purpose: Anarchist persona + introverted/extroverted axis.  Personality axis on social orientation.  Anarchist is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=1.00, n=4) -- both a quiet pamphleteer anarchist and a rabble-rousing-in-public-square anarchist are recognisable.  Question mix: 6 introverted-trait social-preference prompts + 4 extroverted-trait social-preference prompts (the two trait banks ask near-identical questions; the axis modulates which side the persona answers from) + 2 anarchist-role probes + 1 extraction power + 1 hand-written social-energy probe.
